newsitem.title: USA: Exxon says La. refinery operating normally.
newsitem.headline: Exxon says La. refinery operating normally.

text.p: Exxon Corp's 424,000 barrel per day Baton Rouge, La., refinery continues to operate within normal ranges despite shipping delays along the Mississippi River, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
"There have been some (shipping) delays, but nothing that has affected the refinery or our customers," Exxon spokesman Bruce Tackett said.
Crews lightered a volatile cargo of benzene and gasoline from a capsized barge near the refinery earlier this week, but commercial traffic in the area is still restricted, the Coast Guard said.
The barge was being rigged on Wednesday and restrictions on that section of the river could be lifted on Thursday after the barge is moved, Coast Guard spokesman Chris Haley told Reuters.

The barge capsized March 17 after a tow of 25 barges hit a bridge in the fast-moving, flood-swollen river currents. Several other incidents on the river prompted the Coast Guard to issue restrictions on marine traffic, including a one-way, one-vessel or tow at a time limit in the area of the accident.
